title: Defensibility = context-need GATE (abstain-by-default, minimize regret); no-win on self-solvable tasks is CORRECT
summary: Reframe after v7 (7th no-win). Product claim is NOT "context always helps" — it's "retrieve context only when it helps, abstain otherwise, so we never pay the over-deliberation tax." A no-win on self-solvable specs is then the CORRECT behavior (gate abstains → parity with OFF → zero regret), not a failure. GATE (reuses v7 embeddings): run search_knowledge; confidence = top-1 cosine + margin (sharp specific match vs diffuse topical noise); gate on note TYPE (inject only EMPIRICAL scar-tissue gotchas/decisions/root-causes, never general principles — v4 lesson: topically-relevant-but-general note still hurt); DEFAULT = ABSTAIN. Defensibility ARTIFACT: labeled eval, label = "OFF underperforms best ON arm" (ground truth from existing report-v2..v7, no rerun); report REGRET = overhead-when-injected-wrongly + wins-missed-when-abstained-wrongly. On v1–v7 a correct gate ≈0 regret. Headline: "we measurably do NOT lose where memory doesn't help" — differentiator vs blind-inject memory products. Ships conservative NOW; INJECT threshold calibrates once the cross-session winning-case experiment yields positive labels. Implemented as task 688a3742.../4.
